policy.primary: Use reviewed broad polity geography when the polity has an unambiguous horizontal placement.
policy.ambiguous_fallback: When broad polity geography is transregional, compile placement from reviewed temporal polity-place functions instead of a special-purpose capital field.
policy.temporal_segmentation: Split an Activity only on reviewed polity-place-function temporal boundaries. Every segment must have complete reviewed coverage.
policy.regional_consensus: If multiple reviewed place functions are simultaneously active, they may place the Activity only when they resolve to one region. Conflicting regions remain unresolved.
policy.no_partial_placement: A gap or regional conflict anywhere in an Activity prevents silent partial placement of that Activity.
policy.presentation_boundary: Pure display anchors are compile/runtime presentation data and must not masquerade as historical polity-place facts.
policy.no_guessing: Do not infer placement from person names, modern nationality, ethnicity, or unreviewed geometry.
policy.unresolved: If neither reviewed broad geography nor complete reviewed polity-place-function coverage yields one region, keep the Activity unresolved.
policy.subregion_precision: When a reviewed polity has a stable historical subregion inside its macroregion, polity_subregions provides that reviewed coarse precision. Transregional, broad, or temporally shifting polities remain at macroregion precision until reviewed temporal polity-place-function coverage can place them more narrowly.
policy.taxonomy_rule: Split only mixed historical-geographic leaves with reviewed polity evidence on both sides; preserve equal leaf width and keep every migrated leaf actively bound.
policy.horizontal_order: Macro and leaf order follows geographic adjacency first and representative longitude second; South Asia uses Deccan → Maldives → Sri Lanka so the eastern endpoint hands off toward mainland Southeast Asia.
